name: Infinity Metals Limited
summary: Infinity Metals Limited engages in the exploration and evaluation of mineral resource in Australia, Spain, and the United States. It also explores in gold, silver, lithium, tin, and copper deposits. It produces battery grade lithium products. The company was formerly known as Infinity Lithium Corporation Limited and changed its name to Infinity Metals Limited in August 2025. Infinity Metals Limited was incorporated in 2010 and is based in Subiaco, Australia.
